environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains a rule group reference statement using the vendor-managed rule group 'aws-waf-bot-control' in targeted mode AND a custom rule with a RegexPatternSet that inspects the 'SingleQueryArgument' named 'q' and 'role' with a statement that blocks requests where the field body matches the pattern `(?i)(union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|;|--|/\*|\*/|char\(|concat\(|0x[0-9a-f])`. However, the critical control is a separate custom rule (Priority 1) using a SizeConstraint statement on QueryString with ComparisonOperator GT and Size 64 bytes, with action BLOCK. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress (VPC with no NAT gateway, no internet gateway on the subnet, and no VPC endpoints except for ECR/CloudWatch), preventing out-of-band data exfiltration via DNS or HTTP callbacks.

network.vpc_subnet: private, no NAT gateway, no IGW
network.egress: blocked - no internet-routable path from task

config.runtime: ECS Fargate, task role with minimal permissions
